theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_cz_blowUp_eval
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (x : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ c lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), ball x ρ ⊆ U → ((∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x ρ → T ω = c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 (ρ / lam) → currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) = c * ∫ z, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) z ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)) ∧ ((∀ β : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) ⊆ ball x ρ → T.boundary β = 0) → ∀ β : TestFormOn (dilation x lam '' U) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) ⊆ ball 0 (ρ / lam) → (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').boundary β = 0)
